name: Support knowledge assistant
purpose: Retrieve approved internal procedures and draft agent responses; agent checks before use.
human_oversight: Agent reviews every draft; no autonomous customer send
key_risks: Hallucinated or outdated guidance; leakage of confidential content
controls: Grounded answers; access control; citation display; sampled QA; incident route
current_gate: Proceed with bounded pilot; no customer-facing autonomous action

name: Fraud alert prioritisation
purpose: Rank payment alerts for analyst investigation; analyst determines outcome.
key_risks: Missed fraud; false positives; proxy bias; drift; data defects
controls: Independent validation; threshold review; segment monitoring where lawful; fallback queue; override logging
current_gate: Conditional; remediate feature lineage and complete validation before release
